briefs.name: Financial Turnaround Breakdown
briefs.whyItWorks: Builds instant trust by juxtaposing an aspirational wealth milestone or financial rock bottom against a realistic, actionable routine. Shows real numbers and tools on screen to demystify money management.
briefs.hookPattern: These are [number] things I did to go from [undesirable financial state] to [impressive financial milestone]

beats.shows: Creator speaking directly to camera with an inset photo or net worth graph overlay.
beats.says: These are 3 things I did to go from being completely broke to hitting a $100K net worth.
beats.onScreen: 3 Things I Did To Reset My Finances

beats.shows: Close-up cutaway of a mobile budgeting app dashboard showing categorized spending.
beats.says: First, every dollar gets a specific job. Track your real cash flow instead of guessing at the end of the month.

beats.shows: Creator holding their phone, scrolling through automated savings buckets.
beats.says: Second, automate transfers into dedicated accounts so you psychologically can't touch what you're saving.

briefs.name: Psychological Wealth Shift
briefs.whyItWorks: Opens with a counterintuitive observation about money mindsets that subverts audience assumptions, followed by a numbered framework for keeping money saved.
briefs.hookPattern: There are some people who [counterintuitive behavior], because psychologically [reason]

beats.shows: Presenter speaking passionately straight to camera under studio lighting.
beats.says: There are people who say they don't have money even with 10k in their account, because psychologically they don't see it as spendable.
beats.onScreen: HOW TO NEVER RUN OUT OF MONEY

beats.shows: Over-the-shoulder view showing phone screen with digital envelopes and locked budget rules.
beats.says: This rule trains your mind to treat baseline cash reserves as invisible so your bottom line keeps growing.

beats.shows: Presenter gestures forward with clear call to action.
beats.says: Once you build this psychological wall with your budgeting setup, running out of money becomes impossible.
